name: TransNote
author: ariDev1
description: Fast shared text notes: write notes, share with friends, read and comment. Works locally, via shared folders, and over the internet (encrypted). No terminal needed.

barWidget.description: Shared text notes with peer comments

schema.label: Device id
schema.description: Stable name for this machine (e.g. laptop). Peers approve this id to qualify you.

schema.label: Sync folder
schema.description: Folder synced between machines (Syncthing, Dropbox, rsync). Each device writes <deviceId>.json here.

schema.label: Qualified peers
schema.description: Comma-separated device ids (local folder sync) or 64-char hex pubkeys (internet Nostr sync) allowed to read your shared notes. Convert a friend's npub with: node nostr/sync.mjs npub-to-hex --npub <npub>.
